title: Bill Grogan's Goat
transcription:
Bill Grogan's Goat

Bill Grogan's goat, (repeat after each line)
Was doing fine,
Ate three red shirts,
Right off the line,
Bill Grogan came,
Gave him a whack,
And tied him to,
The railroad track,
The whistle blew,
The train grew nigh,
Bill Grogan's goat,
Was doomed to die.
He gave a groan,
Of awful pain,
Coughed up those shirts,
And flagged the train!
